body:
Spin off from #2762

@elarlang said:

> Do you want to keep the V12 title "File and resources" or set more precise focus to "Files"?

I want to have a quick look through after #2772 is merged

comments.body:
These are the only requirements I saw that cause me to doubt:



| # | Description | Level | Comment |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **12.1.1** | [MODIFIED] Verify that the application will only accept files of a size which it can process without causing a loss of performance or denial of service attack. | 1 | **Does this count as resource or is it just a file thing?** |
| **12.1.3** | Verify that a file size quota and maximum number of files per user is enforced to ensure that a single user cannot fill up the storage with too many files, or excessively large files. | 3 | **Is disk space a resource?** |

For me those are nuances for processing files during upload.

From a more philosophical point of view, we can say, that if an uploaded file is read from storage, then it is a resource :)
Ok so can we agree on "File Handling" as the chapter title? Just saying files seems a little weak

> Ok so can we agree on "File Handling" as the chapter title? Just saying files seems a little weak

Yes.

and if you already go and touch this file, remove 2nd item from references
